# Miki

> Queue, booking, and checkout for Malaysian barbershops and service shops. BYOD — use your own tablet. Flat subscription. No marketplace commission.

Miki is a barbershop-first SaaS platform for hybrid **walk-in queue + online booking** on one shared counter tablet. Built for Malaysian SMEs: DuitNow-friendly checkout, cash always works at RM0 platform fee, per-barber revenue on POS.

**Primary competitor context:** Fresha charges per bookable staff (~USD 14.95/member/month), plus payment processing and marketplace commission on new clients. Miki Ocelot is RM109/month flat for up to 4 barbers with no commission on the merchant's own customers.

**Last updated:** 2026-07-09

## Key pages

- [Barbershop product](https://miki.my/barbershop): Features, pricing, trial — walk-ins + bookings, one counter
- [Compare Miki vs Fresha](https://miki.my/compare): Honest comparison with verified Fresha MY pricing and worked cost example
- [Fresha true-cost calculator](https://miki.my/tools/fresha-cost): Estimate Fresha stack vs Miki flat pricing
- [Start free trial](https://miki.my/signup?type=barbershop): 14-day full trial, no card required

## Pricing (Ocelot barbershop, Malaysia)

| Tier | Price | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ocelot | RM109/month | Up to 4 barbers, unlimited online bookings, full offline |
| Founding offer | RM89/month locked | First 50 barbershops per city |
| Ocelot Lite | RM0 | Post-trial only — 1 barber, 25 bookings/mo, QR stays live |

Cash and merchant's own DuitNow QR: RM0 platform fee from Miki.

## Who Miki is for

- Malaysian barbershops and salons (2–4 chairs)
- Shops with mix of walk-ins and Instagram/WhatsApp bookings
- Owners who want predictable monthly cost vs per-transaction fee stacks

## Who should use something else

- Shops that rely entirely on Fresha's global marketplace for new clients
- Full-service restaurants or inventory-heavy retail (see StoreHub, not Miki)
